start.about: On College Green (the road along the green), just up from its crossing, facing away from the hill, down towards the city centre.

areas.name: cathedral
areas.about: About 970 m by 950 m round Bristol Cathedral: Brandon Hill and Park Street down to the Floating Harbour, Queen Square and Wapping Wharf.

areas.name: kingsdown
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m just north of the cathedral area: the University of Bristol and Royal Fort, Tyndall's Park, St Michael's Hill, Kingsdown, Cotham, and down to Lewins Mead and Christmas Steps.

areas.name: stpauls
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the north-east of the cathedral area: Stokes Croft, St Paul's and its squares (Portland, Brunswick, King), the Bear Pit, Bond Street, Cabot Circus and down to Old Market.

areas.name: broadmead
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the east of the cathedral area: Broadmead, Castle Park, Baldwin Street and Welsh Back, Finzels Reach, Victoria Street, Temple Way and Temple Gardens.

areas.name: redcliffe
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the south-east of the cathedral area: Redcliff Hill, Bath Road towards Temple Meads, the Bath Bridge and Bedminster Bridge roundabouts, York Road, Victoria Park and Windmill Hill.

areas.name: southville
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the south of the cathedral area: Coronation Road along the New Cut, Southville, Bedminster's East Street and Cannon Street, and North Street's east end.

areas.name: ashton
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the south-west of the cathedral area: the west of Spike Island and Baltic Wharf, Brunel Lock, Clift House Road, Greville Smyth Park, Ashton Gate and its stadium.

areas.name: hotwells
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the west of the cathedral area: Hotwells and Hotwell Road, the SS Great Britain, Cumberland Basin, Cliftonwood, Jacob's Wells and up to Royal York Crescent.

areas.name: clifton
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the north-west of the cathedral area: Clifton Village, Clifton Down, Queens Road and the Triangle, Whiteladies Road, Pembroke Road and the Clifton Lido.

areas.name: seawalls
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m the north-west corner: the Portway along the Avon Gorge, Sea Walls and the edge of Durdham Down, Rockleaze and Northcote Road, across the river Leigh Woods.

areas.name: whiteladies
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the north-west of kingsdown: the top of Whiteladies Road, Clifton Down and Durdham Down's edge, Westbury Road, Upper Belgrave Road and Redland Hill.

areas.name: redland
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the north of kingsdown: Redland, Redland Green and Redland Grove, Zetland Road, Cotham Brow, and the bottom of Gloucester Road and Cheltenham Road.

areas.name: montpelier
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the north of stpauls: Montpelier, Cheltenham Road and Gloucester Road, Ashley Road, Arley Hill, St Andrew's Park and St Agnes Park.

areas.name: stwerburghs
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m the north-east corner: St Werburgh's, Mina Road and Mina Road Park, Baptist Mills, Lower Ashley Road, Stapleton Road and the St Paul's roundabout on the M32.

areas.name: lawrencehill
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the east of stpauls: Lawrence Hill and its roundabout, Easton Way, Easton Road, Newtown and Lawfords Gate, Stapleton Road's south end.

areas.name: stphilips
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the east of broadmead: St Philip's, St Philip's Causeway, Barton Hill and Barrow Road, Feeder Road along the river, Avon Street and the Temple Quarter campus.

areas.name: totterdown
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the east of redcliffe: Bath Road and Wells Road, Totterdown and Three Lamps, Totterdown Bridge, Arnos Vale Cemetery and St Philip's Marsh.

areas.name: knowle
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m the south-east corner: Wells Road up through Knowle, Broad Walk, Redcatch Road and Redcatch Park, Knowle Park and the top of the Northern Slopes.

areas.name: windmillhill
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the south of redcliffe: Victoria Park's south end, Windmill Hill, St John's Lane, Wedmore Vale and the Northern Slopes.

areas.name: bedminster
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the south of southville: Bedminster's south side, Bedminster Road, Parson Street, South Street, Malago Drive and St John's Lane.

areas.name: winterstoke
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the south of ashton: Winterstoke Road, Ashton Gate Stadium's south side, West Street, Parson Street station and up Bedminster Down Road.

areas.name: ashtonvale
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m the south-west corner: Ashton Vale, Ashton Drive, Ashton Road and Swiss Drive, out towards the Long Ashton bypass.

areas.name: bowerashton
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the west of ashton: Bower Ashton (UWE's campus), the Cumberland Basin's Brunel Way, Clanage Road, Greville Smyth Park's west side and Ashton Court's edge.

areas.name: gorge
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the west of hotwells: the Clifton Suspension Bridge, the Avon Gorge, Hotwell Road, Sion Hill, Rownham Hill, the Plimsoll Bridge and Leigh Woods.

areas.name: observatory
areas.about: About 970 m by 945 m to the west of clifton: Clifton Down and the Observatory, the Promenade, Bridge Valley Road, the Portway below in the gorge, and Leigh Woods across it.
